title: stillingia gymnogyna
intro: Stillingia gymnogyna, commonly known as Tree of Heaven, is a plant species native to the southeastern United States and parts of China. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain, particularly in the treatment of arthritis. The therapeutic actions of Stillingia gymnogyna are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, which are believed to be mediated by its bioactive constituents, including saponins, flavonoids, and terpenoids. The plant's bioactive constituents have been shown to exhibit immunomodulatory and antioxidant activities, contributing to its therapeutic effects.
